prototype: TICVAI Guest Booking v2.dc.html (same app as 'TICVAI Guest Booking v2 (single file).html')
rev: Client rev 3 (feedback 25 Sep 2026; handoff exported 27 Sep; updates and flow review 28 Sep)
howToOpen: Open 'TICVAI Guest Booking v2 (single file).html' in a browser (or the .dc.html with support.js, venueplan.js, stadium3d.js, venuemap3d.js, images/, logos/ beside it). Use the header nav (Discover, What's on, Book, At the venue, My tickets, Help), and the corner engine-controls button (Config drawer) to switch venue type and booking flow.

screens.name: Home / Landing
screens.evidence: <main data-screen-label="WEB-001 Home">; hero carousel with 'Search venues, shows, attractions', 'Pick up where you left off' (home.resume), 'Browse by venue', 'Popular right now' rail, discoverLinks
screens.differences: No first-open venue picker remembered on the device and no 'Change venue' in the header (YAML R267); the prototype shows 'Browse by venue' tiles instead and switches venue from the Config drawer. Prototype adds a resume-booking card, a video 'Tonight in the city' panel, live queue times on cards and footer links to Contact / Accessibility / Service status. YAML emptyNoAccess/offline states are not drawn on Home (offline exists only as a demo tweak).

screens.differences: Prototype adds a right-hand quick-book preview ('list.pick' aside with ticket counters and Continue) that YAML leaves to WEB-004/WEB-005, and shows each card's booking-flow label and live queue time (getWaitTimes is in the YAML). Empty-results copy 'Everything is still on sale — the filter is what narrowed it.'

summary: 46 screens: 21 exact, 24 partial, 1 none (WEB-014 Pay for a Booking). WEB-046 is deferred in the YAML but fully drawn. 17 prototype views have no screen of their own (transport and meeting rooms are the largest). Three most important differences: (1) Booking order and structure. The prototype asks date → time → ticket on one step (Rev 3 item 2) and sign-in after Add-ons (item 3), and the cart is a persistent sidebar. The YAML chains WEB-005 → WEB-006 → WEB-010 and reaches WEB-016 only from home and cart. (2) Checkout and sign-in contradict the 28 Sep decisions. The prototype offers Apple Pay, Tabby split-in-4, pay on arrival and invoice/PO (YAML: card or wallet, R080).
